name: Led Zeppelin

whyMatters.en: London four-piece formed in 1968. Jimmy Page’s guitar and production, Robert Plant’s vocals, John Paul Jones’s bass and keys, and John Bonham’s drums define Led Zeppelin II–IV and Physical Graffiti.
whyMatters.zh: 伦敦四人组，1968 年成立。Jimmy Page 的吉他与制作、Robert Plant 的人声、John Paul Jones 的贝斯与键盘，以及 John Bonham 的鼓，贯穿《Led Zeppelin II–IV》与《Physical Graffiti》。

note.en: Ostinato riff; modal color outside straight blues harmony.
note.zh: 固定音型 riff；非直白蓝调和声的调式色彩。

note.en: From Led Zeppelin II; open riff and a theremin/feedback middle section.
note.zh: 出自《Led Zeppelin II》；开放 riff，中段含 theremin 与反馈。

note.en: From Led Zeppelin IV; acoustic opening into electric close; long FM radio staple.
note.zh: 出自《Led Zeppelin IV》；原声开场到电声收束；FM 电台长期点播曲。

note.en: From Physical Graffiti; repeating ostinato and orchestral arrangement.
note.zh: 出自《Physical Graffiti》；反复固定音型与管弦编曲。

interviewQuotes.text: I think when you hear that drum sound, you know it's Bonzo.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Jimmy Page

interviewQuotes.text: We were just four people who got together and happened to be very good.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Robert Plant

lyricQuotes: If there's a bustle in your hedgerow, don't be alarmed now
You need cooling, baby, I'm not fooling

shortBio.en: Page / Plant / Jones / Bonham hard rock, 1968–1980. Whole Lotta Love and Stairway to Heaven are the main reference tracks.
shortBio.zh: Page / Plant / Jones / Bonham 硬摇滚，1968–1980。《Whole Lotta Love》与《Stairway to Heaven》是主要参照曲。

body.en:
Led Zeppelin formed in London in 1968 after the Yardbirds ended. Jimmy Page handled guitar and much of the production; Robert Plant sang lead; John Paul Jones played bass, keys, and arranged parts; John Bonham played drums. Early albums document blues and folk sources expanded into hard rock for large venues.

Whole Lotta Love (1969), Stairway to Heaven (1971), and Kashmir (1975) show a theremin middle section, an acoustic-to-electric arc, and a long ostinato arrangement. The same four members stayed through 1980; the band ended after Bonham’s death that year.
body.zh:
Led Zeppelin 于 1968 年在伦敦由 Yardbirds 结束后组建。Jimmy Page 负责吉他与大量制作；Robert Plant 主唱；John Paul Jones 演奏贝斯、键盘并参与编曲；John Bonham 司鼓。早期专辑把蓝调与民谣素材扩展为适合大型场地的 hard rock。

《Whole Lotta Love》（1969）、《Stairway to Heaven》（1971）与《Kashmir》（1975）分别呈现 theremin 中段、原声到电声的结构，以及长固定音型编曲。四人阵容维持到 1980 年；Bonham 去世后乐队结束。

body.en:
Led Zeppelin’s sound rests on a fixed division of labor: Page on guitar and production, Plant on vocals, Jones on bass, keys, and arranging, Bonham on drums.

Blues and folk material is rewritten at harder volume and larger form, not only covered note-for-note.

Albums II–IV and Physical Graffiti are the usual entry points for riff writing and dynamics.
body.zh:
Led Zeppelin 的声音建立在固定分工上：Page 负责吉他与制作，Plant 负责人声，Jones 负责贝斯、键盘与编曲，Bonham 负责鼓。

蓝调与民谣素材被改写成更大音量与更长结构，而不是逐句翻唱。

《II–IV》与《Physical Graffiti》是听 riff 写法与动态幅度的常用入口。

title.en: Classic four with almost no changes
title.zh: 几乎无更替的经典四人

body.en:
Unlike many peers, the peak years use one cast: Page, Plant, Jones, Bonham from 1968 to 1980.

Page and Jones came from session work, which shows in arrangement density. Bonham’s death ends the original run.

That stable lineup is why the recorded sound stays consistent across albums.
body.zh:
与许多同辈不同，巅峰期几乎是同一套人马：Page、Plant、Jones、Bonham，1968–1980。

Page 与 Jones 有录音室出身，编曲密度较高。Bonham 去世后原班运行结束。

阵容稳定，也使各专辑的录音面貌相对一致。

body.en:
Page writes parts and mixes. Plant carries melody and lyric imagery. Jones supplies bass, keys, and charts. Bonham supplies the groove weight later metal bands often cite.

There were almost no substitutes in the classic period.
body.zh:
Page 写分声部并混音。Plant 扛旋律与歌词意象。Jones 提供贝斯、键盘与谱面。Bonham 提供后来金属常引用的 groove 重量。

经典时期几乎没有替补。

body.en:
Led Zeppelin II (1969) opens with a repeating riff and Plant’s vocal, then a theremin and feedback middle before the return.

The track keeps hard-rock single length while using studio effects mid-song.

It remains one of the band’s most cited early singles.
body.zh:
《Led Zeppelin II》（1969）以反复 riff 与 Plant 人声开场，中段进入 theremin 与反馈，再回到主题。

曲长仍接近 hard-rock 单曲，但中段使用了录音室效果。

它仍是乐队早期最常被提及的单曲之一。

body.en:
Led Zeppelin IV (1971) places a fingerpicked opening, layered guitars, then Bonham’s entry and a solo section.

FM radio made the long form a frequent request. The arc runs from acoustic start to a heavier finish.
body.zh:
《Led Zeppelin IV》（1971）以指弹开场、多层吉他，随后 Bonham 进入并进入独奏段。

FM 电台使这首长曲成为常见点播。结构从原声起，到更重的收束。

body.en:
Interview lines often stress how recognizable the four players sound together.

Page’s remark on Bonham’s drums points to tone and performance, not costume or myth.

Quotes here work as oral notes on arrangement and playing.
body.zh:
访谈常强调四人合奏的辨识度。

Page 关于 Bonham 鼓声的说法指向音色与演奏，而非戏服或传说。

此处引语可作编曲与演奏的口述笔记。

body.en:
NWOBHM and metal often take the riff weight. Punk often rejects the length and excess. Grunge keeps heavy low end and drops much of the fantasy lyric.

Later bands still cite, sample, or push against the Zeppelin catalog.
body.zh:
NWOBHM 与金属常取 riff 重量。朋克常拒绝其长度与过量。Grunge 留下偏重的低频，并丢掉大量奇幻歌词。

后来乐队仍会引用、采样或针对 Zeppelin 曲目作出回应。

note.en: Only peak lineup; minimal member changes across the original run.
note.zh: 唯一巅峰阵容；原班运行期间成员更替极少。

note.en: Early hard-rock single with a clear riff and studio middle section.
note.zh: 早期 hard-rock 单曲；riff 清楚，中段含录音室处理。

note.en: Blues and folk forms expanded for arena hard rock; metal and grunge still answer the catalog.
note.zh: 蓝调与民谣形式扩展为体育场 hard rock；金属与 grunge 仍回应这套曲目。
